warnings: PNG contains TWO portrait BOQ sheets laid out side by side in one landscape scan, per spec §11. Rotate the PNG 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. The physical RIGHT half is the LOWER-numbered sheet and is written to _1.json; the physical LEFT half is _2.json.

EVERY PRICE COLUMN IS BLANK ON EVERY ROW OF THE WHOLE BOQ -- ราคาหน่วยละ, จำนวนเงิน (material and labour), and รวมค่าวัสดุและค่าแรงงาน. This is a แบบ ปร.4 QUANTITY schedule issued unpriced by กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง for the estimator to fill in. Nulls are transcribed, never invented.

The title block is identical on every sheet of the set: form แบบ ปร.4, drawing numbers S-62047 / AR-61142 / SN-62034 / EE-62062 / M-62028, สถานที่ก่อสร้าง ทั่วไป, unit บาท, with ประมาณการโดย and ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ left blank.

*** THIS SHEET IS THE MISSING DOOR/WINDOW COUNT. *** A-22 and A-23 give the door and window TYPES with full specifications but no quantities, and A-05/A-06 mark positions with symbols that could not be reliably split into doors and windows at 1:100. Here is the tally: D1 x2, D2 x1, D3 x3, D4 x1, D5 x4 (11 doors) and W1 x2, W2 x4, W3 x6, W4 x1, W5 x2, W6 x2 (17 windows), 28 openings in all.

*** IT ALSO CONFIRMS THE MATERIAL SPLIT READ OFF A-22/A-23 EXACTLY: D1 is the only ALUMINIUM door (the 3.10 m living-room slider) and D2-D5 are UPVC; every window W1-W6 is aluminium. *** That is precisely what the two schedules specify.

The BOQ marks are D1..D5 and W1..W6, whereas the architectural sheets number them ประตู 1..5 and หน้าต่าง 1..6 inside symbol outlines. Same items, different notation -- the D/W prefix is what removes the ambiguity the plans left.
W3 at 6 units is the most common opening -- the 0.60 m single casement, which fits its use as a secondary light in bedrooms and service rooms.
Every line is measured in ชุด (sets), i.e. frame, sash, glass and hardware complete, matching the way A-22/A-23 specify each type.
